Generate birthdates as separate year/month/day components

Source: R/person-age.R
fkr_birthday_split.Rd

A convenience wrapper around fkr_birthday() that splits each generated date into its year, month, and day parts – handy for forms that collect date of birth as three separate fields.

Usage

fkr_birthday_split(n, ..., age = NULL, ref_date = Sys.Date())

Arguments

n

Number of birthdates to generate. A single non-negative whole number.

...

Passed on to fkr_age() (e.g. age_range, bias). Ignored if age is supplied.

age

Optional precomputed ages to generate birthdates for; see fkr_birthday()'s age argument.

ref_date

Reference "today" that ages are computed against. Default Sys.Date().

Value

A data.frame with n rows and character columns year ("YYYY"), month ("MM"), and day ("DD").

Examples

fkr_birthday_split(5)
#>   year month day
#> 1 2023    12  29
#> 2 1990    05  19
#> 3 2019    01  19
#> 4 1996    04  24
#> 5 2019    11  01
